title: 1 Chronicles 24
paragraphs: ¹ These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. ² But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests. ³ David, together with Zadok from among the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech from among the sons of Ithamar, organized them according to their appointed duties in the service. ⁴ Since there proved to be more leaders among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar, they were divided accordingly — sixteen heads of families from the sons of Eleazar and eight from the sons of Ithamar. ⁵ They were assigned by lot, equally, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar.

⁶ Shemaiah son of Nethaneel, a Levite scribe, recorded the assignments before the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of the priestly and Levite families — one family being drawn for Eleazar and then one for Ithamar. ⁷ The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah, ⁸ the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim, ⁹ the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin, ¹⁰ the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

¹¹ the ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah, ¹² the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim, ¹³ the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab, ¹⁴ the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer, ¹⁵ the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

¹⁶ the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel, ¹⁷ the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul, ¹⁸ the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah. ¹⁹ This was the order in which they were to carry out their service when entering the house of the LORD, as their ancestor Aaron had directed them, following the command of the LORD, the God of Israel. ²⁰ As for the remaining descendants of Levi: from the sons of Amram came Shubael, and from the sons of Shubael came Jehdeiah.

²¹ Concerning Rehabiah: from his sons, Isshiah was the chief. ²² Of the Izharites: Shelomoth, and from his sons came Jahath. ²³ The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth. ²⁴ Of the sons of Uzziel: Michah; and from Michah's sons came Shamir. ²⁵ Michah's brother was Isshiah, and from Isshiah's sons came Zechariah.

²⁶ The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And from the sons of Jaaziah came Beno. ²⁷ The sons of Merari through Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri. ²⁸ From Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons. ²⁹ As for Kish, his son was Jerahmeel. ³⁰ The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of the Levites by their families.

³¹ Like their kinsmen the sons of Aaron, these also cast lots before King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the priestly and Levite families — senior family heads alongside their younger relatives.
